description: Record what the rep did about a surgeon's reasons from my_day: called (off the list for 90 days), not_now (30 days) or not_relevant (for good). A new kind of reason brings the surgeon back. For a call or visit that happened, also log it with log_visit.

kinds.description: The reasons' kinds as my_day lists them (reasons[].kind), e.g. ["switch_risk", "expand"].

npi.description: 10-digit NPI; use search to find it.

name: handle_reason
title: Say what was done about a reason to call
